analyses.content: 录音提到这里以“buggy ride”（马车体验）闻名，这指的是由单匹马拉的轻型车，对应选项B的“horse-drawn ride”。
不要因为听到了“museum”就去选H，那是当地人纪念Thania Jackson建的，并不是Jackson Town目前最出名的游览项目。

"We would begin from Jackson Town, which is known for its buggy ride. Rather than sit in a train, you will sit in a small lightweight carriage pulled by a single horse. It was named after Thania Jackson, who was famous for her generosity in the region. The locals even built a museum for her."
录音明确说明原计划的直升机取消了，现在通过“jolly train ride”（愉快的火车旅程）前往，对应选项A。
不要因为听到了“helicopter”就错选D，它已经被天气原因中断了，也不要被“cakes”误导去选E或F。

"Belleville would be our next stop. We'll get there by helicopter. Oh. Oh, I almost forgot that this mode of transportation has been suspended because of the variable weather. We will get there by taking a jolly train ride, which is a highlight in this area. The people here are very friendly and would always try to make you feel as comfortable as possible. They entertain their guests with local delicacies like cakes and pastries, which are quite famous in this area."
文中提到这里受欢迎的热气球旅行（balloon trip）会让人尖叫，这属于“exciting trip in the air”。
不要因为听到了后面的“relaxation spots”（休闲点）就以为是这里的特色，热气球旅行才是它最核心的卖点。

"Albany is a very lively and playful place, so get ready for some good and hearty laughs. It is usually fun to watch some people screaming during a balloon trip, which is quite popular there. Albany also features cool relaxation spots where you can just take time to cool off and enjoy yourself."
饼干因为“teddy bear shapes”（泰迪熊形状）而出名，这对应了“animal-shaped baked food”。
不要听到结尾提到的“chiffon cakes”就去选蛋糕相关的选项，Teddy bear形状的饼干才是Fort Scott的特色。

"Fort Scott is where we have Jackson's Biscuits, which is famous for its teddy bear shapes. There you can get to see how they're pieced together. The location also has a small refreshment section where you can grab a bite. The chiffon cakes there are just palatable."
这里生产的蛋糕使用“pure”（纯净）原料且“No food additive”（无食品添加剂），对应选项E的“natural ingredients”。
不要听到最后一句提到的“native culture”就去选G，那是隔壁Greensville的特色，不要串台了。

"Rawlins has many factories there. Among these factories, the ones that make cakes are gaining more fame than others. Their cakes are made from pure cream, cheese, eggs, and sugar. No food additive. I always advise our tourists to get some for themselves and their families, as their products will never disappoint you."
录音明确提到Greensville以其“Native American culture”（美国原住民文化）为傲，这就是选项G。
这里的“art museum”只是用来放文物的地方，不是它出名的主要原因，不要被“museum”误导去选H。

"Rawlins Council has decided to combine their products with the native culture in the future, which will be a strong selling point. Greensville boasts about its Native American culture, which is widely known. A lot of artifacts have been collected around here and now kept in the local art museum for studies and tourists' sake. A lot of people who had been looking for their roots have been able to make a sort of connection by coming to this place."
幼儿园目前的位置就在Monument Street的“north”（北边），地图上对应的就是H。
不要听到后面说要搬去Oak Road就去地图上找Oak Road，因为现在还没搬，当前位置还在Monument Street北边。

"Greensville has a good kindergarten for younger children, and it is situated just to the north of Monument Street. It has well-trained teachers and a conducive environment for learning. As it's receiving an increasing number of children, the city council has decided to move it to a larger site on Oak Road this November. The new spot is uncertain, though."
既然位置在“end of Ash Road”（Ash路的尽头），那对应地图上Ash路顶端的A点就是答案。
只要听到道路指示语“at the end of”，就应该直接去地图上找对应道路的终点，不要被后面关于展览的干扰信息带跑。

"We also have a craft shop which is at the end of Ash Road. The craft shop is for displaying all types of art and drawings, paintings, and the likes. It is a key feature of Greensville due to its art exhibitions which run three times a year."
学校“used to be”在交叉口（G点），但现在搬到了那个旧址的“right beside”（旁边），也就是C点。
听到交叉口的名字不要急着选G，一定要听清它是“旧址”，新地址在它旁边才是正确位置。

"Wixon's School used to be situated at the intersection of Oak Road and George Avenue, but the site wasn't big enough as the number of students kept growing. So the larger piece of land right beside the old location has become the new site for the school since last year. It is important to note that the school has been around for a while, so there are well experienced teachers to help students develop at their own pace."
这是一个非常清晰的位置描述：“between Monument Street and Maple Street”，地图上两条街中间的区域就是F。
只要听到“between”这种空间关系词，就要立刻在地图上两条街的夹角寻找，不要在地图其他地方浪费时间。
"The cake factory that we spoke about is actually between Monument Street and Maple Street, just by the roadside."
